question: What happens when one established in the nonconceptual path enters through any level of reality?
premises: One may be established on the nonconceptual path.
Such a one may enter through any path from earth up to Sadashiva.
Any such entry can culminate in Shiva-identity.
inference: Therefore for one on the nonconceptual path, every level of reality can become a doorway to becoming Shiva.
plain_english: One who is established on the nonconceptual path, by whatever route he enters—from earth up to Sadashiva—by that very route he becomes Shiva.
